Title: SQL Injection Authentication Bypass
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Submitting ' OR 1=1-- returns 200 OK and JWT for admin@juice-sh.op
Root_Cause: Raw string concatenation in SQL query without parameter binding
Business_Impact: Full admin takeover and complete database compromise
Remediation: Use parameterized queries with Sequelize ORM bindings

Title: Weak Password Policy and Lack of Rate Limiting
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Accepts 1-character passwords; 100+ rapid automated logins succeed without lockout
Root_Cause: Missing schema complexity checks and lack of rate-limiting middleware
Business_Impact: Vulnerability to credential stuffing and brute-force account takeovers
Remediation: Enforce 12+ character policy with regex and integrate express-rate-limit

Title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on Basket
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Modifying bid=3 to bid=2 exposes cart items of another user
Root_Cause: Server trusts client-provided ID without validating against JWT session
Business_Impact: PII leak and unauthorized cart tampering
Remediation: Bind basket queries strictly to authenticated req.user.bid from JWT

Title: Missing Function-Level Access Control (Admin Panel)
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Unprivileged user can navigate to admin UI and fetch all system users
Root_Cause: Missing server-side RBAC middleware and missing Angular route guards
Business_Impact: Privilege escalation and unauthorized admin actions
Remediation: Implement verifyRole('admin') middleware and Angular AdminGuard

Title: DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Submitting <iframe src="javascript:alert('XSS')"> executes script in DOM
Root_Cause: Search query rendered into DOM via bypassSecurityTrustHtml
Business_Impact: Session hijacking via localStorage JWT theft and phishing overlays
Remediation: Use Angular standard text binding and sanitize with DOMPurify

Title: SQL Injection in Product Search Filtering
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Injecting UNION SELECT payload leaks user credentials in product table
Root_Cause: Raw concatenation of search string into SQL LIKE clause
Business_Impact: Database exfiltration and intellectual property leak
Remediation: Use parameterized queries with Sequelize Op.like bindings

Title: Missing Defensive Security Headers and Info Leakage
Minimal_Proof_Sanitized: Missing CSP / X-Frame-Options / HSTS; leaks Server: Express
Root_Cause: Default Express configuration lacks HTTP security headers
Business_Impact: Clickjacking iframe attacks and targeted version-specific exploits
Remediation: Implement Helmet.js middleware with strict CSP and hidePoweredBy
